info.title: bim-review-coordinator browser API
info.description: Coordinator Browser Contract. Generated from bim-review-coordinator/src/contract (zod); do not edit. Covers coordinator-owned routes the browser calls; /api/governance/* and /api/kit/* proxies are owned upstream.

get.summary: Coordinator-visible runtime summary for operator surfaces.
Read the live session idle-reclaim policy.

put.summary: Operator live override of the session idle timeout (revision + process epoch guarded).

post.summary: Create a Review Session (explicit create or legacy single-session).

get.summary: Page through archived (closed) Review Sessions with rebuildability.
Read one Review Session.

post.summary: Recreate a closed Review Session from its server-owned ready artifacts (Idempotency-Key required).

get.summary: Browser bootstrap for Kit streaming: canonical trace, WebRTC endpoints, stage composition.

post.summary: Console reports the first real video frame for a session.
Close a Review Session (resumable checkpointed close).
Viewer activity heartbeat for idle reclaim (requires an active viewer lease).

get.summary: Idle countdown state for one session.

post.summary: Enqueue a metadata-only issue snapshot to the cloud callback outbox.
Claim the editor (primary) or a spectator viewer lease.
Keep a viewer lease alive and report stage/DataChannel evidence.
Release a viewer lease.

get.summary: Lease occupancy and Stage Binding Transaction summary for the caller.

post.summary: Preauthorize one stage composition; returns a pending Stage Binding Transaction.
Cancel a pending Stage Binding Transaction by client request id.
Create an A4 focus/highlight handoff intent from governance evidence proofs.
Consume an A4 handoff intent once inside the 3D workspace.

get.summary: ConversionLedger operator projection.

post.summary: Open, create or reuse a Review Session for a MinIO ready model.
Move a queued ifc-ready job to the front of the serial dispatch queue.
Re-queue a failed or dropped ifc-ready job.

put.summary: Enable or disable the MinIO Watch Surface loop.

post.summary: Manually trigger (or force re-trigger) conversion for one MinIO object key.

get.summary: Quality metrics summary for one conversion job (read through the conversion authority).

post.summary: IFC-ready intake (external worker or MinIO watcher self-post); idempotent by key.

get.summary: Recent ifc-ready intake jobs with lifecycle and failure projection.
One ifc-ready intake job with artifact health and recovery action.

post.summary: Open or attach the Review Session for a converted ifc-ready job.

get.summary: MinIO Watch Surface status counters.
Browse the governed MinIO bucket (folder or flat listing).
Find governed source bundles whose verified manifest references one MinIO IFC object.
Alignment reports produced by conversions, newest first; optionally for one MinIO IFC object.
One conversion's alignment report summary, file digests and MinIO upload outcome.
One page of one difference set from a generated alignment report.
Operator summary of the cloud callback outbox (metadata only).

post.summary: Start a CFD wind run for one converted model (design comparison only); coordinator binds the exact model.usdc sha256.

get.summary: Ledger of CFD runs (refreshed from the streaming job service when enabled).
Status of one CFD run (streaming cfd-run-status/v1 plus ledger projection).
cfd-run-result/v1 with overlay/run-record URLs rewritten to the public streaming origin.
Exclusion list (cfd-exclusion-list/v1) of one CFD run.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running CFD run.
Register one finished CFD direction as an overlay ArtifactBinding on the session; load it with the existing stage-binding flow.

delete.summary: Remove a CFD overlay binding from the session (files are kept in the job store).

anyOf.description: legacy: open or reuse the single session for this ready model
